text: The two computers' lines were merged in b100e43 (meta_agent/failures.jsonl merge-1), on the person's words to this session on 2026-11-23, said in conversation and not yet in docs/ideas: '적절히 합치고 싶은데' (I want them merged properly), '둘의 장점을 판단하면서' (judging the merits of both), and, asked whether the merge commit may be made without the pre-commit hook since no seat's commit of a merge passes checks 6, 20 and 21, '훅 없이 커밋, 메시지에 명시' (commit without the hook and say so in the message).
